mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park, a full moon, a temperature of 30 degrees, an overnight low of 28 degrees, and no rain in the forecast.
The City of Verona reminds residents that tax bills will arrive by December 15, with options to pay online, by mail, or at the 24/7 drop box at the City Center.
We have a busy schedule with trivia today at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga sessions happening tomorrow and throughout the rest of the week.
In a notable weekly incident from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an O W I arrest.
Today's delicious flavor is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and since the restaurant is open until 10:00 PM, you still have plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
